clue.text: Nearly last, team let up in scrummaging

indicators.note: a rugby scrum is a heaving jumble of bodies, so the letters of the preceding words are packed down into a new order

explanation.surface: A rugby side eases off in the scrum near the end of the match.
explanation.walkthrough: 'scrummaging' shuffles TEAM, LET, UP and IN together; the 'in' looks like a link word but its letters are needed.
explanation.definitionFit: Penultimate is the standard word for second from the end, i.e. almost the final one.

clue.text: Dead loud material turned up containing Queen gem

indicators.note: containing means the reversed run holds another piece inside it
in a down clue, turned up means the pieces are read from bottom to top, i.e. backwards

parts.note: lamé is a flashy metallic fabric, so it is a loud material
ER is the royal cipher, Elizabeth Regina

explanation.surface: A garish dead fabric is flipped over around a royal jewel.
explanation.walkthrough: One indicator, 'turned up', turns the dead-plus-fabric run as a whole (giving EMALD), which then wraps the royal cipher by 'containing'.
explanation.definitionFit: An emerald is a green precious stone, a classic example of a gem.

clue.text: Pull out guns, heat he's holding

indicators.note: holding means the phrase guns, heat he's carries the answer within its run of letters

explanation.surface: A gunman with a hot weapon is asked to draw.
explanation.walkthrough: The answer runs across gUNS HEAT HE's, with 'holding' as the signal.
explanation.definitionFit: To unsheathe a blade is to draw it from its scabbard, i.e. pull it out.

clue.text: Bird on top of the man for pay

indicators.note: in a down clue, on top of puts the first piece above the second

parts.note: a tit is a small songbird
he refers to the man

explanation.surface: A bird perches on a man's head for payment.
explanation.definitionFit: A tithe was a tenth of produce paid to the church, so a form of payment or levy.

clue.text: Was wrong to condone following girl endlessly

indicators.note: following means the to-plus-condone pieces come after the shortened girl
endlessly means the last letter of the word for girl is dropped

parts.note: miss is a young woman or girl
to OK something is to approve or condone it

explanation.surface: Someone erred by letting a young woman off.
explanation.definitionFit: Mistook is the past tense of mistake, so it means erred or was in error.

clue.text: Playing notes in lack of harmony

indicators.note: playing suggests notes being performed loosely, so the letters of notes and in are rearranged

explanation.surface: A musician hits wrong notes, producing discord.
explanation.definitionFit: Tension between people is strain or friction, the absence of harmony.

clue.text: Power of right in vote for one town

indicators.note: in means the letter for right goes inside the run of other pieces

parts.note: to elect is to vote for someone
I is the Roman numeral one
a city is a large town

explanation.surface: A town chooses who has the right to rule.
explanation.definitionFit: Electricity is electrical power, as in the mains supply.

clue.text: Male wearing gaiters raised fashions

indicators.note: wearing means the reversed gaiters are put on around the letter for male
in a down clue, raised means the word for gaiters is read upwards, backwards

parts.note: spats are short gaiters worn over shoes

explanation.surface: A man in spats sets new trends.
explanation.walkthrough: 'raised' turns SPATS into STAPS, and 'wearing' puts M inside it.
explanation.definitionFit: To stamp metal is to shape or form it, so stamps means fashions as a verb.

clue.text: They rent out B&B perhaps

definitions.meaning: people who let property to tenants
B and B are two alphabet characters

explanation.definitionFit: Those who let are landlords, and B and B are two characters of the alphabet.

clue.text: One sober after, say, tea infusion

indicators.note: after places the one-and-sober pieces behind the spoken letter
say signals that the word tea is used for how it is spoken, as a single letter

parts.note: the drink tea is pronounced like the letter T
I is the Roman numeral one
sane means sober or level-headed

explanation.surface: Someone clear-headed after a cup of tea.
explanation.definitionFit: A tisane is a herbal tea made by steeping leaves, i.e. an infusion.

clue.text: Stupidly eat TV dinner getting careless

indicators.note: stupidly signals the following words are jumbled foolishly into a new order

explanation.surface: Eating a TV dinner is a lazy, thoughtless habit.
explanation.definitionFit: Inadvertent describes something done without care or attention, i.e. heedless.

clue.text: Appear to get level for match

indicators.note: to get means the word for appear receives another piece inside itself

parts.note: to come is to appear or arrive
par means level, as in on a par

explanation.surface: Turning up level for a game.
explanation.definitionFit: To compare things is to set them side by side, to see if they match.

clue.text: Wearing down love god in embracing love

parts.note: Eros is the Greek god of love

indicators.note: embracing means the word in hugs the letter for love

parts.note: O is love, a zero score in tennis

explanation.surface: Cupid's counterpart is caught in a lovers' clinch.
explanation.walkthrough: 'embracing' puts O inside IN to make ION.
explanation.definitionFit: Erosion is the gradual wearing away of rock or soil by wind and water.

clue.text: Embarrassed about a skirt initially pulled down

indicators.note: about means the word for embarrassed is placed around the other letters

parts.note: embarrassed people go red in the face

indicators.note: initially picks the opening letter of skirt

explanation.surface: Someone blushes when her skirt slips down.
explanation.walkthrough: 'about' puts A and S, the first letter of 'skirt', inside RED.
explanation.definitionFit: Rase is a variant spelling of raze, to demolish a building completely.

clue.text: Set etched with ink irregularly

indicators.note: irregularly means the letters of etched and ink are put in a disordered arrangement

explanation.surface: An etching inked unevenly.
explanation.definitionFit: A sauce that has set has stiffened or become firm, as thickened does.

clue.text: Open University?

definitions.meaning: to start or set up something, such as an inquiry
a university is an example of an academic body or college

explanation.definitionFit: To institute is to begin or set up, and an institute is an academic body such as a college.

clue.text: Offensive wing left in game

indicators.note: in means the arm and left pieces sit inside the word for game

parts.note: chess is a board game
an arm is a wing of a building or organisation

explanation.surface: A military offensive on the left flank in a war game.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Offensive' looks like a noun for an attack; here it is the adjective, meaning unpleasant.
explanation.definitionFit: Charmless means lacking any appeal, so unpleasant or offensive.

clue.text: The empty deceit in rising artist's studio

indicators.note: in means these pieces go inside the reversed artist
in a down clue, rising means the word for artist is read upwards, backwards

parts.note: RA is a Royal Academician, a crossword artist

indicators.note: empty means the inside letter of the is removed, leaving only its outer letters

parts.note: a lie is a deceit

explanation.surface: A painter's studio built on a hollow lie.
explanation.walkthrough: 'artist's' is not part of the definition: RA, a Royal Academician, is turned to AR by 'rising', and 'in' wraps it round the hollowed 'The' plus the lie.
explanation.definitionFit: An atelier is an artist's or designer's workshop, a studio.

clue.text: Gathering idiot's broken some pottery

indicators.note: broken means the idiot gets in among the letters of the pottery, splitting it

parts.note: Ming is fine Chinese porcelain from the Ming dynasty
an ass is a fool or idiot

explanation.surface: A clumsy fool has smashed a valuable vase.
explanation.walkthrough: Ming is a dynasty whose porcelain is famous, so 'some pottery' is a fair pointer; 'broken' signals the fool splitting it open.
explanation.definitionFit: Massing means assembling into a crowd, a gathering together.

clue.text: Detect original water source, extremely originally

definitions.text: Detect original water source, extremely originally

indicators.note: originally picks the opening letter of each of the five preceding words

explanation.surface: A water diviner seeks out the very first spring.
explanation.walkthrough: The whole clue describes the activity, and its first letters spell the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: To dowse is to search for underground water with a divining rod.

clue.text: Separate girl's fashionable hugging novel woman

indicators.note: hugging means the girl's and fashionable pieces wrap round the woman

parts.note: Di is a girl's name, and the possessive adds S
in means fashionable
Jo March is a heroine of the novel Little Women

explanation.surface: A stylish girl embraces a fictional character.
explanation.walkthrough: The novel is Louisa May Alcott's Little Women; 'hugging' signals the wrap-around.
explanation.definitionFit: Disjoin is a verb meaning to detach or pull apart.

clue.text: Little, almost disgusting creature

parts.note: wee is Scottish for small or little

indicators.note: almost means the word for disgusting loses its final letter

parts.note: vile means disgusting

explanation.surface: A tiny, rather revolting beast.
explanation.definitionFit: A weevil is a small beetle, so a living creature.

clue.text: Taliban leader with justification for national crime

indicators.note: leader picks the first letter of Taliban

parts.note: a reason is a justification

explanation.surface: A Taliban chief excuses an offence against the state.
explanation.definitionFit: Treason is betrayal of one's country, the crime against a nation.

clue.text: Desperate character holding top up for nymph

indicators.note: in a down clue, up means the whole assembly is read from bottom to top
holding means the comic hero's name contains the word for top

parts.note: Desperate Dan is a strongman in the British comic The Dandy
A1 means first-rate or top, written AI

explanation.surface: A frantic figure clutches the summit to spot a water spirit.
explanation.walkthrough: Desperate Dan is a British comic-strip strongman; with A1 inside him (DAIAN), 'up' turns the whole result round.
explanation.definitionFit: A naiad is a water nymph of Greek myth, living in rivers and springs.

clue.text: Possibly beetle around quiet study

indicators.note: around means the word for the bug goes about the letter for quiet

parts.note: a beetle is one example of an insect
P is piano, the musical direction for quiet

explanation.surface: Looking closely at what might be a beetle in silence.
explanation.definitionFit: To inspect is to examine closely, which is to study.

clue.text: Costume that's worn in some parts

definitions.text: Costume that's worn in some parts

parts.words: Costume that's worn in some parts
parts.note: a two-piece swimsuit covers only certain body parts, and it is worn in parts, as two pieces

explanation.definitionFit: A bikini is a two-piece swimming costume covering only a little of the body.

clue.text: Fantastic jumper perhaps straddled by posh Scotsman

indicators.note: straddled by means the garment sits between the posh and Scotsman pieces

parts.note: U means upper-class or posh
Ian is a typical Scottish man's name
a jumper is an example of a top, a garment for the upper body

explanation.surface: A Scot in a sweater, posh on both sides.
explanation.walkthrough: U for upper-class comes from a 1950s British debate over posh versus common usage; 'straddled by' signals the sandwich.
explanation.definitionFit: Utopian means idealised and impractical, so fanciful or fantastic.

clue.text: Actress exploded inside in teen hit

indicators.note: inside means the word for exploded goes into the jumbled letters
hit suggests the letters are knocked about into a new order

parts.note: raged means flew into a fury, exploded

explanation.surface: An actress lost her temper on a teen show.
explanation.walkthrough: 'hit' rearranges the letters of 'in teen' into TIENNE, and 'inside' puts the fury word after its first letter.
explanation.definitionFit: A tragedienne is a female actor specialising in tragic roles.
